Name: AI Governance
Description: Findings for how AI agents, agent identities, and the Copilot agent catalog are governed in Microsoft 365: sponsor/owner coverage, classic Copilot Studio service principals without an Agent ID, catalog adoption, blocked-package requests, direct user assignment, tenant-wide custom package deployment, MCP server transport security and host allowlisting, destructive/open-world MCP tools in tenant-wide packages, agent skill description hygiene, blueprint credentials nearing expiration, and Copilot spending-policy credit ceilings, group governance, and overlap.
